common: Standalone educational illustration for Japanese elementary grades 2–4. Warm colored pencil and watercolor, clear shapes, realistic relative scale, no labels or text.

assets.prompt: Near vertical aerial view of ONE rectangular Japanese rice paddy approximately 20 meters by 50 meters, within several surrounding paddies. Main paddy outlined by natural earthen berms, visually clearly the subject; nearby modest farmhouse roof about 8 by 10 meters and narrow 3-meter farm road accurately in scale. Show whole paddy from overhead, not eye level.

High altitude near vertical aerial view, ONE square block of lush Japanese rice paddies approximately 100 meters on each side (1 hectare total). Within the square ten distinct rectangular paddies in a 2 by 5 arrangement separated by thin earthen berms; square outer boundary unmistakable. On the outside edge a tiny realistic farmhouse roof only 8 by 10 meters (one tenth the square side) and a narrow 3-meter road; same scale everywhere. Whole square fills middle 70 percent of frame. No giant house or people; aerial land survey feel.

Very high altitude near vertical aerial panorama of an ENTIRE Japanese rural village region about 5 kilometers across by 6 kilometers deep, no horizon. Hundreds of small farm plots, many clusters of tiny house rooftops, a modest town center, winding river, rural roads and wooded hills inside the region. Individual 10-meter houses must appear as tiny flecks and individual rice fields as small rectangles, vast rural landscape from aircraft, NOT one field. Natural illustration consistent with accurate cartographic relative scale.

A Japanese elementary child brushing their teeth at the bathroom sink, hand holding toothbrush at mouth with a little toothpaste foam, ordinary home morning scene, cropped medium view. Clearly tooth brushing.
Japanese elementary children seated at classroom desks eating school lunch with chopsticks, rice bowl, soup and tray. Clearly eating, all children seated, warm school scene.

Japanese elementary school lunch preparation BEFORE eating: children in clean white lunch-serving coats and caps ladling soup and serving rice from school lunch trolley onto trays, classmates waiting in a line with empty trays. Nobody eating, clearly preparing and distributing food.

Single standalone illustration containing a clear left-to-right visual sequence of the SAME Japanese elementary child through a FULL school day: arriving at school gate in morning with backpack, learning at classroom desk, eating lunch, leaving school gate in afternoon with backpack. Four evenly spaced complete scenes seamlessly arranged across landscape, no frames, no text, no clocks, no numerals. Clearly whole school day, not one class.

Japanese elementary classroom during a lesson, teacher teaching at blackboard and children seated at individual desks writing in notebooks, visible open textbook, attentive pupils. Blackboard has only geometric sketches with no writing or numbers.

Japanese elementary children on a short break in school playground, happily chatting, skipping rope and playing a gentle ball game, school building behind. No teacher delivering lesson, no desks, clearly recess rather than class.

Scientific educational macro illustration on white background of the sharpened tip of an ordinary yellow HB wooden pencil, recently sharpened then slightly used. Graphite ends in a small blunt flat writing contact tip rather than an infinitely sharp point. Large close-up; show exposed wood and dark graphite distinctly. Two thin measurement extension lines and one double-headed arrow span ONLY the width of the approximately 1 mm blunt graphite contact end, perpendicular to pencil axis, never along its length and never across whole wooden pencil. Include subtle smaller whole pencil at lower corner for context. No text including HB, no numbers or units. Clean precise graphite anatomy.
